name: Discovery Adventures
description_short: Three-day and five-day themed day programs at Old Sturbridge Village, a living history museum, held during February, April and summer school vacations. Kids explore part of the Village's history and environment, do hands-on crafts, and get an afternoon snack.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Page only mentions Summer 2026 programs, which are already over as of 2026-10-13; no 2027 sessions are listed yet.
The page lists no session dates, prices or themes; they appear to be on a linked 'Learn More & Sign Up' page that wasn't provided.
Age range depends on the season: ages 6-14 for February/April and 6-17 for summer. The recorded 6-17 reflects summer.
Phone number is Old Sturbridge Village's general museum line, not a program-specific contact.
Scholarship contact email is obfuscated on the page ('[email protected]'), so it wasn't recorded.
Discounts mentioned: 10% sibling discount when registering in the same transaction; OSV members also get a discount (amount not stated).
